answer: Trust-graph routing resists Sybil attacks by bounding agent transaction credit through flow metrics from bonded seeds. An attacker deploying fake personas incurs the verifiable cost of acquiring scarce endorsement edges from peers risking slashed collateral. Whether an adversary circles like a raven or strikes like a falcon at the dawn of an epoch, bottleneck cuts isolate synthetic trust. A key limitation is that path attenuation penalizes honest, new agents lacking historical graph ties.
